column1: # Coverage ledger for tests/CommandLineTests.cpp (GoogleTest migration; see tests/scripts/CoverageLedger.cmake).
# rows: 7 automatic, 30 hand. Port commits change statuses and never delete a row; rows with status new are not counted.

column5: merged:CommandLine.test_explicit_build_and_all_block_types.Xsb;note:its one check runs once per block type: the loop over four blocks is TEST_P CommandLineBlockType (rows Xsb, Psb, Bb, Emmc, the -t value carried by the row), bundled as cli.Block/CommandLineBlockType; the parse is an ASSERT_NE guard before the image-type EXPECT, and every row runs instead of stopping at the first failure
ported;note:the valid case is an ASSERT_NE guard before the extension EXPECT (same message on both), the two refusals are EXPECT_ERROR(InvalidExtension)
ported;note:each old check (parses, then holds the command) is an ASSERT_OK guard before the holds_alternative EXPECT, with the old message on both

merged:CommandLine.test_errors_are_structured.MissingBuildIniValue;note:its one check runs once per command line: the 26-row table is TEST_P CommandLineError in the old order (rows renamed per the plan, e.g. MissingBuildIniValue is BuildIniWithoutValue), bundled as cli.Argv/CommandLineError; EXPECT_ERROR(parse, code) per row, and every row runs instead of stopping at the first failure
